# Research paper to Chinese patent draft

Curated by Skill Harbor — @yuan1z0825's workflow for turning research papers or inventor materials into Chinese invention patent drafts and technical disclosures (技术交底书): a router that detects the source format (PDF, scanned PDF, pasted text), task mode (full draft, claim set, disclosure analysis, technical disclosure, disclosure iteration, paper-patent audit) and invention type (algorithm/software, apparatus, process/material), then works through stage gates — stable source IDs for every paper block, equation, figure and code fragment, a strict support-state ledger (explicit / inherent / needs-confirmation / unsupported, with unsupported features excluded from claims), claims drafted before the specification, formal Chinese deliverables (权利要求书, 说明书, 说明书摘要, 摘要附图), Mermaid system/process diagrams rendered into DOCX with native editable Office Math for formulas, and a validation script that must pass before delivery. Honest caveats: **formal documents are produced in Chinese** (agent-facing analysis can use your language); **a drafting aid for inventor and patent-professional review, not a patentability opinion, infringement opinion or filing guarantee** — the skill says so itself; requires Python and the bundled scripts (validate/build/disclosure renderers). Apache-2.0 licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
